name: What is involved in converting a garage into a guest suite?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in converting a garage into a guest suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a garage into a guest suite is a substantial residential design-build project that transforms an underutilized space into a fully functional living area. This process typically involves structural modifications, ensuring proper insulation, integrating plumbing for a bathroom or kitchenette, updating electrical systems, and selecting interior finishes to create a comfortable and aesthetically pleasing environment. AKN Design Group manages this entire process, from initial design and permit coordination to construction and final walkthrough, ensuring a cohesive and functional new space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting a garage into a guest suite involves structural modifications, plumbing, electrical updates, and interior finishes to create a functional living space. AKN Design Group manages the entire design-build process.
